text:
oncall-bot: [ALERT] Prod us-west-1 kvcache memory growth >85% on inference-svc, continuous batching tokens/sec spiked.

maya: paging SRE, seeing KV cache growth + draft/target mismatch heatmap, perf cliff on p99 tail.

akshay: on it, can someone share which model pool? suspected speculative-decoding rollout last night.

sofia: model-pool: rwd-gpt-medium-quant (dedicated). Last deploy 02:14 UTC, speculative-decoding:enabled via feature flag.

maya: logs show repeated divergent drafts causing cache churn and huge draft-length keys; sample log:
```
[2026-03-14T02:33:01Z] spec-decode: draft_len=512 target_len=34 kv_key_len=546 cache_entries_added=1240
[2026-03-14T02:33:01Z] kvcache: mem_used=78% -> 92% (delta +14%)
```

jamie: that's consistent with speculative + continuous batching; multiple concurrent spec branches produce unique KV prefixes.

akshay: mitigation plan: 1) flip speculative flag off for model-pool, 2) reduce continuous batching window to 5ms, 3) apply temporary max_kv_entry_size to 256.

maya: +1. Can you push the flags? We may need a hotpatch to avoid overnight customer impact. Estimated customer requests affected: some generation timeouts and elevated latency on 4 tenants.

akshay: performing hotpatch now. running:
```
redctl svc set-flag --env prod --pool rwd-gpt-medium-quant speculative_decoding=false
redctl runtime set-config --env prod --pool rwd-gpt-medium-quant batching_window_ms=5 max_kv_entry_size=256
```

deploy-bot: Started rollout of config to rwd-gpt-medium-quant in prod (stage 1/5). Check logs at https://console.redwood.io/logs/rollout/abc123

maya: monitoring metrics, mem usage trending down from 91% -> 67% within 90s. p99 latency improved from 1.8s -> 1.2s on affected routes.

sofia: rolling back speculative flag retained? We should keep it off until further root cause analysis and a safe gating for draft deduping.

akshay: confirmed rollout finished stage 5/5. All hosts report speculative_decoding=false. KV cache insert rate down 89%.

alice: oncall handoff in 30m; summarize customer impact for handoff: 4 customers with transient timeouts (<=2m), degraded p99 for 12 minutes, no data loss. Any incidents to create?

maya: open P1 incident doc, mark mitigated and assign to eng-runtime + ML-research for follow-up: dedupe speculative draft generation & kv key canonicalization. Also add postmortem to incidents channel tomorrow.

jamie: note: prioritize a guard in runtime to cap KV entries per request, and evaluate prefix hashing to collapse identical drafts.

maya: thanks team. I'll prepare the handoff doc and notify customer success for outreach. :thumbsup:
